output.summary: A deciduous tree native to northeastern and central China and Taiwan, tree-of-heaven grows rapidly and spreads aggressively by seeds and root sprouts. All parts have a strong smell, often compared with peanuts or rotting cashews, and the tree can quickly recolonize after cutting.
output.edibilityNote: Roots are poisonous to humans; illness has also been reported after ingesting other plant parts or water contaminated by flowers.
